# Hash-pinned install set for the OTLP extra in ci.yml's otlp-receiver job.
#
# Direct requirements: opentelemetry-proto>=1.20.0 protobuf>=4.21.0
#
# Deliberately a SECOND file rather than more names in ci-tests.txt. The
# otlp-receiver job installs the base set first, then this, because the
# point of the job is to exercise the receiver with the optional `otel`
# extra present (setup.py: `clawmetry[otel]`). Folding these two names into
# the shared file would install them for the other six test jobs too, and
# would then hide exactly the bug that job exists to catch: OTLP code that
# imports opentelemetry unconditionally rather than behind the optional
# guard. Keeping the second install separate keeps every job's dependency
# surface the same as it was before this pin.
#
# Installed with `pip install --require-hashes`, which refuses to install
# anything not listed here with a matching hash. Every transitive dependency
# is present because --require-hashes demands the whole closure; here the
# closure is just the two direct names, which have none of their own.
#
# Each version lists the sha256 of EVERY distribution PyPI publishes for it
# (wheels for each platform, plus the sdist). pip accepts a download that
# matches any one of them, so the pin does not quietly depend on the runner
# resolving to the same wheel this file was generated against.
#
# Updating: the `/.github/requirements` pip entry in .github/dependabot.yml
# (group pattern `*`) covers this file; see ci-tests.txt for the note on
# that entry arriving with PR #5889.
#
# Regenerating by hand, on Linux / CPython 3.11 to match the job:
#   pip install --dry-run --ignore-installed --report r.json \
#     "opentelemetry-proto>=1.20.0" "protobuf>=4.21.0"
# then, for each resolved name==version, take every sha256 under `urls` in
# https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/<version>/json.

opentelemetry-proto==1.44.0 \
    --hash=sha256:898b155a0e1557afd867478fb6158e8122a46329ca0bb8dc53cc55e98f017f56 \
    --hash=sha256:c547a79c2f8c0c515d31509154682e5921c7cfd5ca67b70e1f9266e2c3e103f3
protobuf==7.36.1 \
    --hash=sha256:0b53ce95272aad50ad25d7ff03373743209822e8ba42ea7fad27d2bee1547d00 \
    --hash=sha256:39c518c05586c016d7874ff6079ee115bcec1ea5fbb1d177fbf7867ef4c67e44 \
    --hash=sha256:3cf2ee25d006cee57294a1196ea43b37feb78e0dcd1e8af5c1aeddb777655aca \
    --hash=sha256:43d3d37b1eb24c113b9b7d02008cac44e423f00b611b7781ae998d7623972969 \
    --hash=sha256:51139351435d9b43d88a55eaa49fb6f737fbb478fb0cbf2cf694d1a04a9d3363 \
